title: Workspace onboarding
idea: Workspace onboarding: A readiness checklist separates configured tested and enabled capabilities
audience: People who need to setup workspace within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic process layout through its setup workspace priority and explicit commitment contract: A configured integration is not verified until its check succeeds
navigation: Workspace onboarding keeps the current setup workspace context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A readiness checklist separates configured tested and enabled capabilities
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to setup workspace; admin setup spans real dependencies
composition.priority: A configured integration is not verified until its check succeeds

imagery.role: Support the actual setup workspace context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Prioritize blocked dependencies with an explicit next action
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the workspace onboarding structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no setup workspace content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; A configured integration is not verified until its check succeeds
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized setup workspace content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: A configured integration is not verified until its check succeeds
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active setup workspace context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
